answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted identity: every agent must lock a refundable deposit before transacting, slashed when its behavior is proven fake. Like quartz forming only under sustained pressure, a genuine identity accrues slowly through verified work, while a sybil farm must pay full price for each copy — the attacker faces shale-thin margins because every fake identity costs as much as a real one. A yarrow-style reputation graph then cross-checks attestations, so clusters of identities that only vouch for each other stand out and forfeit their stake together.
